title: @modelcontextprotocol/hono
excerpt: @modelcontextprotocol/hono Hono adapters for the MCP TypeScript server SDK. This package is a thin Hono integration layer for @modelcontextprotocol/server. It does not implement MCP itself. Instead, it helps you: create a Hono app with sensible defaults for MCP servers parse JSON request bodies and expose them as c.get('parsedBody') for Streamable HTTP transports add DNS rebinding protection via Host header validation (recommended for localhost servers) Install Exports createMcpHonoApp(options?) hostHeaderValidatio...
